name: Adelaide
source:
Tarot: The Hierophant
Music Genre: Angry female hip hop, orchestral movie tracks
Likes: Cake, cute house decor, small animals
Dislikes: Pop up visits, surprise parties, insecure people

Adelaide experiences a lot of insecurity but is very good at hiding it. 
She's especially insecure about how intensely she feels her emotions. 
This leads to her avoiding getting close to others.
            
Gets overwhelmed fairly easily but this is because she has
an emotionally exhausting job and social mask. Tends to 
be irritable around friends because she is so tired.

Gets worked up fairly easily and will engage in fights if pushed, 
though it is much harder to provoke her now that she is older. 
She fought with people who spoke poorly of Aiyana in high school.

[From in-game profile]
